_comment: Hybrid routing (Resolve-HybridWorkflowRoute). asisAboveReferencePx: stream-copy when resolution ref px is GREATER THAN this (SBS uses coded width when w>=2*h, else longer edge; default 2048=2K). flat*: bitrate below threshold -> flat encode; else fisheye. defaultKindWhenBitrateUnknown: asis|flat|fisheye when probe has no bitrate. asisSegmentSuffix: Skybox token for Run-SegmentCopyAsIs (3d_op_%02d_<suffix>.mkv). Override per media folder: hybrid_workflow.json beside media_files.txt. Env: HYBRID_WORKFLOW_CONFIG=full path.
